name: StatList
description: Key figures as a description list: each item pairs a figure with what it counts, an optional total and a short note.

variant.description:
"rule" sets each figure under a hairline, for figures inside running
content; "card" puts each on a surface tile, for a standalone band.

size.description: Figure size: md for rows of four or more, lg for two or three.
